method: Actual baseline and candidate service worker/cache paths, deferred Thread, stub metric builder, one fixed ticker and benchmark, same one-second mock provider callback and fake cache clock. Candidate additionally injects the refresh clock and waits; baseline has no successful-round wait. No live provider or Supabase.

peer_limit_comparison.fixture: Same peer, three tabs with two windows each, then sixteen excess connection attempts

stopping_condition: Declared age and response availability invariants, atomic admission/release, expiry, reconnect cooldown and manual-intent races, shared-window behavior, client lifecycle regressions and fresh review pass.
limits: Synthetic counts and calculation age are not production provider quotas, market-price freshness, distributed limits, live acceptance or real-user study evidence. The lifecycle fixture applies the same disconnect protocol externally to both service revisions; actual client pause behavior is verified separately.
